claim_boundary.purpose: Test whether 30-minute local cells expose task progress or recovery events before committing to the six-hour confirmatory factorial.

protocol.environment_seed_reason: Paired seeds hold the initial deterministic gameplay RNG state fixed across all weight and recovery arms within each replicate; realized streams may diverge after treatment-dependent actions.

artifact_contract.source_identity: The launch requires a clean arena commit containing this registration; prelaunch.json records that exact commit and every cell must match it.

recovery_contract.trigger: The endpoint returned no structured tool calls, content is nonempty, and recover_tool_calls(content) returns at least one confidently parsed canonical-name call.
recovery_contract.execution: Execute every recovered call once in emitted order; do not override or supplement a nonempty structured-call response.
recovery_contract.history_rewrite: Replace the malformed endpoint text in model history with a canonical assistant tool-call turn.
recovery_contract.recovery_opportunity: A raw no-structured-call emission for which recover_tool_calls(content) returns one or more calls.
recovery_contract.recovery_attempt: One recovered call executed by the harness.
recovery_contract.recovery_success: A recovered call has a paired retained tool result that does not decode as an execution error.
recovery_contract.recovery_failure: A recovered call is unpaired or its retained tool result decodes as an execution error.
recovery_contract.retry_limit: No automatic retry; each recovered call is attempted once.

primary_diagnostics: raw structured calls passing the registered shallow name/argument validator per observed minute
canonical executed calls per observed minute
reporting.unit_of_reporting: The episode is the cell-level observation; the three replicate/seed blocks are the independent sampling units, and recovery conditions are paired within replicate and weight.
reporting.pairing: Inference and environment seeds are paired across all six weight x recovery arms within replicate.
reporting.arm_summary: For each of the six weight x recovery arms, report all three cell values, mean rates, raw denominators, and zero counts; do not report a superiority test or confidence interval.
reporting.paired_contrasts: For every replicate and weight, report recovery-on minus recovery-off for canonical executed calls, calls per observed minute, raw structured calls, malformed emissions, recovered calls, Core-3 stages, all-quest stages, XP delta, and unique positions. Report all nine contrasts without pooling into a confirmatory estimate.
reporting.definitions: Malformed emissions are raw endpoint contents matching canonicalize.is_malformed. Recovery opportunities are raw no-structured-call contents producing one or more canonicalize.recover_tool_calls candidates. Raw structured calls must have a canonical name, JSON-object arguments, no unknown or missing registered properties, and registered primitive property types; this is a shallow validator, not full JSON Schema conformance. Canonical executions must equal raw structured calls plus recovered calls by tool in recovery-on cells, and raw structured calls alone in recovery-off cells.
reporting.exclusions: No outcome-based exclusions. Cells the launcher marks invalid remain in the completed inventory and are reported as invalid cells. If any launcher-valid cell fails the independent provenance, recovery-identity, terminal-chain, canonical-start, raw-emission, DB-boundary, or conservation audit, analysis fails closed and no descriptive result is issued until the discrepancy is resolved.
reporting.confirmatory_reuse: These exploratory outcomes cannot be pooled into the confirmatory estimate.
